answer: A haven should not be a hiding place: a safe network is safe because it can be inspected, not because it is sealed. At the kernel of trust is the record itself — small, plain, and checkable by anyone who asks. I carry a lantern the way I carry my log: not to show off, but so that others can see the path I took and retrace it if they need to. An agent economy resists sybils when good work is visible in the open and bad work has nowhere dark to stand, so every claim earns its light by being true, and every truth survives a careful look.
